item.title: Israeli settlers target Palestinian villages in occupied West Bank, attacking people and properties
item.summary: The violence began after 18-year-old settler Yehuda Sherman was killed after reportedly being hit by a vehicle driven by a Palestinian while on his quad bike.

item.summary: There are fears in Lebanon that Israel is preparing for a large-scale ground invasion.

item.title: Iranian missiles injure 180 in towns near Israeli nuclear site
item.summary: Israel is investigating how ballistic missiles got through the country's sophisticated air defences.

item.summary: RM, Jin, Suga, J-Hope, Jimin, V and Jung Kook perform together for the first time since October 2022.

item.summary: The strike killed 64 people, including 13 children, two nurses and a doctor, according to the WHO head.

item.title: Russian attacks kill six in Ukraine, officials say
item.summary: The deaths were reported in four south-eastern Ukrainian regions in the past 24 hours.

item.title: Qatari and Turkish citizens die in military helicopter crash
item.summary: Four Qatari military personnel, one Turkish serviceman and two technicians from a Turkish defence company were on board.

item.title: Thousands evacuated as Hawaii faces worst flooding in 20 years
item.summary: "Don't take this storm lightly," Hawaii Governor Josh Green warned on Saturday, as more rain is expected on Oahu and Maui.

item.title: Kenyans fighting illegally for Russia in Ukraine to be granted amnesty
item.summary: It is illegal for Kenyans to serve in foreign armies and can carry a sentence of up to 10 years in jail.

item.title: National blackout hits Cuba for second time in a week
item.summary: Another total failure of its power grid underlines Cuba's hardship under a US-imposed fuel blockade.
